dialogs.about: 거실 벽에 새로 건 그림을 할아버지와 함께 보며

lines.en: Look at our new picture on the wall.
lines.ko: 벽에 새로 건 우리 그림을 보세요.

lines.en: It looks good there. What do you see first?
lines.ko: 거기 잘 어울려요. 무엇이 먼저 보여요?

lines.en: The red boat in the foreground.
Where is the focal point for you?
The sea line. It's horizontal and calm.
lines.ko: 바다 선이요. 가로로 놓여 있고 잔잔해요.

lines.en: I see. That tall tree is vertical.
Yesterday I looked at its depth again.
Did you see the diagonal road too?
Yes! Please move it a little left.
Sure. I am going to move it now.
Good morning. Today we will study perspective.
Good morning. That sounds hard to me.
It's easy. Draw a horizontal line first.
Like this? Where does the middle line go?
Right here. Do you see the depth now?
Oh yes! Does this line make symmetry too?
lines.ko: 아, 네! 이 선이 대칭도 만들어요?

lines.en: Not really. But the proportion looks good.
lines.ko: 꼭 그렇지는 않아요. 그런데 비율은 좋아요.

lines.en: The roof looks too big to me.
Try again. Last week you did very well.
lines.ko: 다시 해 보세요. 지난주에도 아주 잘했어요.

lines.en: Thank you. I will practice at home tonight.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 오늘 밤 집에서 연습할 거예요.
